newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanian Central Bank's foreign currency reserves stand at around $650 million, Jordanian prime minister says.
- Union National Bank of United Arab Emirates studies plans to increase its capital, chairman says.
- Trade exchange between Saudi Arabia and China in 1995 totalled $1.48 billion.
- Qatar welcomes Bahrain's decision to pardon two Qataris convicted of spying for Qatar.
- Saudi Arabia is expected to project a 150 billion riyal spending in its 1997 budget.
